item.title: Snow Damage Leaves Brooklyn Wellness Studio Seeking Support
item.description: The Brooklyn Wellness Club, a Black-woman-owned wellness studio in Bed-Stuy, is looking to raise some funds after the shed in the backyard collapsed during the January snowstorm.

item.title: Man Struck by Stray Bullet in Sunset Park
item.description: Authorities say the man fired multiple rounds toward an unknown target just after 6:00am on Sunday in front of 214 48th St., as the victim exited a nearby building and was struck in the leg.

item.title: ICE Raid in Brooklyn: New Yorkers Pepper-Sprayed
item.description: Chaos unfolded in Brooklyn on Tuesday evening when ICE agents showed up and tussled with local residents who sought to prevent them from detaining a man.

item.title: How Mobile Technology Is Revolutionising Personal Entertainment Options
item.description: For urban professionals moving at full tilt, downtime no longer means sitting in front of a television or desktop at a set time. The daily commute or a short break between meetings is now enough for meaningful digital engagement, all powered by the smartphone in your pocket. This isn’t just about convenience; it marks a wider change in how we access culture, leisure and information in a permanently connected world.

item.title: Feb 26: Brooklyn Black History Maker, Christopher Wallace aka The Notorious B.I.G.
item.description: Wallace was one of the greatest and most influential rappers of all time.

item.title: Celebrate Lunar New Year at The Brooklyn Children's Museum
item.description: There's a full day of family-friendly activities, include a lion dance parade, Chinese musical performances, a kung fu workshop on March 1.

item.title: Brooklyn Residents Swindled in $850K Ponzi Scheme
item.description: Marat Likhtenstein, 65, of Sheepshead Bay, allegedly stole money from five Brooklyn residents after promising them a 30% return on their investment. It is his second indictment for alleged financial fraud, according to the Brooklyn District Attorney.

item.title: Brooklyn Navy Yard Launches MWBE Retail Incubator
item.description: Gluten-free and sugar-free specialty bakery Monshe marks the first business to operate at the Brooklyn Navy Yard’s rotating storefront space showcasing emerging local entrepreneurs.

item.title: Brooklyn Unscripted: Ogechi Egonu
item.description: Brooklyn Unscripted is a monthly series where Brooklynites unpack the serious — and not so serious — issues shaping the borough. This month we shine the spotlight on Ogechi Egonu, a model with an ice-cream making habit.
